code: import{useCallback,useEffect,useState}from'react';import{fetchOrgBindings,addOrgBinding,updateBindingStatus,deleteBinding}from'../services/vendorHierarchyService';export const useOrgBindings=orgId=>{const[bindings,setBindings]=useState([]);const[loading,setLoading]=useState(false);const[error,setError]=useState(null);const refresh=useCallback(async()=>{if(!orgId){setBindings([]);return;}setLoading(true);setError(null);try{const data=await fetchOrgBindings(orgId);setBindings(data);}catch(err){console.error('Failed to load bindings',err);setError((err===null||err===void 0?void 0:err.message)||'Failed to load bindings');}finally{setLoading(false);}},[orgId]);useEffect(()=>{refresh();},[refresh]);const createBinding=useCallback(async payload=>{if(!orgId){throw new Error('Organisation ID is required');}const created=await addOrgBinding(orgId,payload);await refresh();return created;},[orgId,refresh]);const updateBinding=useCallback(async(bindingId,payload)=>{const updated=await updateBindingStatus(bindingId,payload);await refresh();return updated;},[refresh]);const removeBinding=useCallback(async bindingId=>{await deleteBinding(bindingId);await refresh();},[refresh]);return{bindings,loading,error,refresh,createBinding,updateBinding,removeBinding};};
